authority: design-witness.csv fixes token assignments; this generated lock defines their interpretation. Change sources only through a reviewed design version, then regenerate this lock.
metadata_only_decision: Access is historical privilege expressed indirectly by allowed hardware/topology. Signal is fixed origin metadata, not current telemetry; no extra signal paint pass. Visual importance is not a layer requirement.

semantics.requires: AND of groups, OR within any_of; IDs in each group must share a category
semantics.max_count: Hard edition-wide cap; target_count is exact in this release
semantics.weight: Relative planning preference, not an independent probability; exact quotas dominate
semantics.reserved_legendary: architecture.severed_halo allowed only explicit legendary IDs

incompatibility_rules.asset_rule: No generic anatomical fallback; NONE/INTACT omit assets. Non-empty trait layers are required. Socket/depth validation is an additional visual gate.

genesis_overrides.policy: Complete individually authored scene, including environment, seam and final transform. Metadata MUST retain every fixed Genesis trait. No generic singular overlay.

unknowns: Whether the event was witnessed live or reconstructed from a later reconciliation
